title: demand-capture client config
description: Per-client configuration for the demand-capture routine (LU-R9). Zero hardcoded client values — all client-specific data lives here, not in the engine. The engine substitutes {service}, {city}, {state}, {occupation} placeholders at runtime from CLI args + this config.

client_slug.description: Client identifier matching the folder name under second-brain/04_projects/clients/_active/ and the *.config.json slug

domain.description: Client's primary domain (used in NO-MIRROR assertions and GSC matching)

gsc_property.description: GSC property URL — domain-property (sc-domain:X) or URL-prefix (https://X/). Must match the client's *.config.json gsc_property.

state_abbrev.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation for this client's service area. Used in query templates via {state}.

location_code.description: DataForSEO location code. 2840 = US (national). State/metro codes available at DataForSEO docs for hyperlocal volume.

occupation.description: The trade/occupation used in head-term query templates via {occupation}. This is client-specific config, not hardcoded in the engine.

volume_head_terms.description: Generic head terms always included in the S3 volume pull. Supports {service}, {city}, {state}, {occupation} placeholders. These terms are included alongside the template-generated per-service/city keywords.

volume_templates.description: Template patterns for building per-service/city volume keywords. Supports {service}, {city}, {state}, {occupation} placeholders.

sonar_query_templates.description: Perplexity Sonar query templates for S5 answer-engine capture. Supports {service}, {city}, {state}, {occupation} placeholders.

chatgpt_gemini_query_templates.description: ChatGPT/Gemini manual query templates for the gated S5 step. Supports {service}, {city}, {state}, {occupation} placeholders.

service_display_names.description: Override service slug → display name mapping. If a slug is not listed, hyphens are replaced with spaces (e.g., 'panel-upgrade' → 'panel upgrade'). Use this when the natural display form differs from the slug (e.g., 'ev-charger-installation' → 'EV charger installation').
